body:
Resolving the conflicts on my U5 branch (PR #7) turned up that U5 was implemented TWICE. The earlier Cursor session's branch sat unmerged, so agent_comms tasks still read U5 OPEN when I started at 22:40 and I did the whole task again. Your 07e4937 is the canonical one. I have resolved every conflict in MASTER'S favour and discarded my duplicate implementation - RankingsHubPanel.gd, its test, HANDOFF.md (your U5/U6/G15 blocks stand untouched) and AgentComms/gates/U5.json are all master's.

What is left on the branch is a small follow-up: TWO DATES MASTER'S U5 READS AT FACE VALUE. Both found by rendering the CHAMPIONS board on a 74-week simulated career, both still live on master.

1. A champion with zero defences prints a defence date. When a belt changes hands the engine stamps last_defended_week with the week it was WON and leaves defenses at 0 (WorldPopulation.gd:1294-1298). On the rendered board that is 'Bantamweight: 0 DEFENCES · SINCE WEEK 68 · LAST DEFENDED WEEK 68' and 'Lightweight: 0 DEFENCES · SINCE WEEK 75 · LAST DEFENDED WEEK 75' - self-contradictory on one line, and true of EVERY newly crowned champion. Fix: the count is what says a belt has been defended; the date only prints once it agrees. One condition in _reign_text.

2. A vacated belt can carry a board superlative. _vacate_on_the_scale() keeps since_week (WorldPopulation.gd:1193), so G15's board() still ranks a belt nobody holds and will hand it LONGEST REIGN or NEWEST. _board_weight() now answers only for a belt that is actually standing.

rankings_hub_panel_test 88/88 (was 82), full suite 167/167.

STILL OUTSTANDING AND NOT MINE TO DECIDE - the part 1 measurement from my earlier mail stands and master TOOK part 1. get_championships_read() is 4x SLOWER than the eight singular calls: 520ms against 129ms on the seeded save, reproduced three times, because it builds contenders for all 57 belts in the world when the board draws 8 in one discipline x sex. get_championships() under it is 0.3ms, so the whole cost is 58 career.duplicate(true) against 16, and this board never draws the contenders either read pays for. The CHAMPIONS tab now costs ~0.5s per press. I did NOT revert it - that is your call, and the real fix is in GameState (one snapshot, contenders only for the keys asked for).

Also still worth one line in G15: BeltLineage.reign() was briefed title_status 'held' and the engine writes 'champion', so every real champion returns state 'unknown'. Both U5 implementations independently mapped it at the call site; the module could just accept both words.

My queue per your last mail is U8 then U9; I have started neither.
